summary:
Fixed search-RAG control arm stub-retrieval bug. Root cause: /search returns both ingested session NOTE nodes (kind='knowledge') and harness TASK STUB nodes (kind='task', probe/* bench/* prefix) in the same result set; stubs ranked above notes and produced 0% accuracy.

BEFORE: run_rag_control (arms.py) and run_search (probe_runner.py) passed raw hits directly to the answerer. hit_keys were probe/q1-* or bench/q1-* stub keys.
AFTER: _is_note_hit (arms.py) and _is_session_note_hit (probe_runner.py) filter out kind='task' AND probe/|bench/ prefix keys; search over-fetches k*3 then trims to k note hits. hit_keys are now note:note-* session note keys.

Accuracy change: confirmed filter excludes bench/realistic-A-* stubs while keeping all 12 session note hits in live workspace; 0 stubs leaked. Unit test accuracy change from 0% (context was task metadata) to sane (context is session memory) — LLM answerer not invoked for this verify but context_blocks now contain real session text.

DEFENSIVE (cross-probe stub pollution): autowireNewTaskWholeGraph seeds task->task candidate edges so older probe/bench stubs CAN appear as /judge/next providers for a new probe. Added _is_note_provider filter in run_canonical_wiring step 4 to exclude stubs from EdgeJudge candidates. If ALL candidates were stubs (filtered to empty), judge_idle=True is set correctly. CONFIRMED: this pollution path EXISTS (daemon.js:1448-1462 taskCands path seeds anchor->other-task edges); fix guards against it.

Also fixed step 2 search in run_canonical_wiring (AGENTS.md bullets) with same _is_note_hit filter for consistency.

Commit: e1efd47 on orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-30 (2 files, +82/-10 lines). Fidelity counters: 0 stubs leaked in all verified paths.

subject: Fix search-RAG control arm: it retrieves harness probe/bench task stubs instead of ingested session notes (→ 0% control, invalid comparison)
description:
BLOCKER for a valid benchmark (found by /29). The search-RAG control arm (GET /search?q=) returns the harness's own probe/bench TASK STUBS (bench/q1-*, probe/q1-*) ranked above the ingested session NOTE nodes → empty/garbage context → 0% accuracy on both datasets. That makes our-way look trivially better than a broken baseline; the comparison is invalid until fixed.

Root cause to address: probe task stubs are ANCHORS (autowire fires FROM them to session notes), not retrievable MEMORY. They must be excluded from retrieval as TARGETS in BOTH arms: (a) the search-RAG arm must retrieve only ingested session notes (filter out task/probe/bench stub nodes), and (b) defensively confirm probe stubs are not eligible autowire CANDIDATES for other probes (the our-way arm reads its own task's judged context, so it's likely fine, but verify there's no cross-probe stub pollution at scale).

Files: bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py (run_rag_control + the search call), client.py (search filtering if needed). Flat task off main (arms.py is on main at 843d979/b2cc620). Verify on the synthetic fixtures: the search arm now retrieves session notes (not stubs) and gets non-zero, sane context; our-way stays correct; fidelity counters stay clean. Hang guards as before (drains off, per-call 120s, bounded smoke). Honesty bar: gold never in retrieve/keep/answer.
